name: create_outlook_event
label: Create Outlook Event
description: Create an event in the user's Outlook.com calendar. Use this tool when the user explicitly asks to create, add, schedule, or save a calendar event.

subject.description: Title or subject of the calendar event.

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: 2026-08-20.

start_time.description: Start time in 24-hour HH:MM format. Example: 14:00.

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Usually the same as start_date.

end_time.description: End time in 24-hour HH:MM format. Example: 15:00.

location.description: Optional event location, such as an address, office, restaurant, or Microsoft Teams.
